title: Waku Waku 7
overview:
Here they come, the top-marks, full-of-energy Waku Waku fighters!!

A wide variety of moves, blazing battles! The Waku Waku Gauge can be used in all sorts of ways.

Legend says that whoever gathers all seven Waku Waku Balls can have any wish granted. Seven fighters each hold one ball, and now they battle to claim the rest. Choose your fighter from a cast that includes Rai, Arina, Dandy-J and Marurun, and take on the others in one-on-one bouts fought over the best of three rounds.

Punch and kick buttons in light and hard strengths, special moves, throws and wall bounces keep fights lively. Fill the Waku Waku Gauge to unleash super moves - including Doki Doki attacks and slow but unblockable Hara Hara attacks - or power up in Super Mode. Every ball you win in the single-player game raises the gauge's maximum level.

- 1 or 2 players
- This edition comes packaged with the Extended RAM Cartridge the game requires
- Memory backup
